# Esputnik

eSputnik is a marketing automation platform that enables businesses to manage and automate their communication channels, including email, SMS, web push, and mobile push notifications.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/esputnik/.

## Actions

- **Add Orders Bulk**: Transfer orders in bulk to eSputnik.
- **Bulk Add or Update Contacts**: Bulk add or update up to 3000 contacts asynchronously.
- **ADD_DOMAIN**: Register a domain for web tracking or widgets.
- **Change Token Activity**: Action to change (activate/deactivate) the activity state of a mobile push token.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact by its Yespo ID.
- **Delete Contact by External ID**: Delete a contact by externalCustomerId.
- **Delete SMS Message**: Delete a base SMS message by ID.
- **Get App Inbox Message** (read-only): Retrieve an App Inbox message by ID.
- **Get Broadcasts** (read-only): List broadcasts from eSputnik.
- **Get Contact Import Status**: Retrieve the status of a contact import session.
- **Get Contact Subscriptions** (read-only): Retrieve subscription categories for a contact.
- **Get Organization Balance** (read-only): Retrieve the current organization balance.
- **Get Organization Billing History** (read-only): Retrieve the organization billing history by day and media channel.
- **Get Preprocessor File Status**: Retrieve the status of a preprocessor file upload session.
